mapper.insert: INSERT INTO academic_cache(user_id,cache_type,credential_version,payload,fetched_at,fresh_until,stale_until,updated_at) VALUES(#{userId},#{cacheType},#{credentialVersion},#{payload},#{fetchedAt},#{freshUntil},#{staleUntil},#{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT(user_id,cache_type) DO UPDATE SET credential_version=excluded.credential_version, payload=excluded.payload, fetched_at=excluded.fetched_at, fresh_until=excluded.fresh_until, stale_until=excluded.stale_until, updated_at=excluded.updated_at
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM academic_cache WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND cache_type=#{cacheType}
